info.title: Open Alpha2 API
info.description: The local control panel of `com.open.alpha2` on the UBTECH Alpha 2 robot (Android 5.1.1, API 22), the HTTP + WebSocket API. Generated from `MainActivity handleApi()` / `HttpServer`, it covers all local robot capabilities (the original 17 AIDL interface functions, now by direct drive), plus the separate system/xiaozhi/stream/upload namespaces. By default it is served as plain HTTP on `HttpServer.PORT = 8888` (`http://:8888/`), reachable by any browser on the same WiFi. All `/api/*` answers are `application/json; charset=utf-8` of the `{ok: boolean, ...}` shape, with an `error` field on failure. A 401 always carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="panel"`. Live events (touch/ASR/battery/fall/PIR and more) are pushed over `GET /ws` (RFC6455 WebSocket), not polled. The experiment tab has an opt-in panel token (`/api/system/auth/*`, see PanelAuth.java): off by default (fully open); when enabled the whole panel is locked — all `/api/*` (read calls, other pages, Blockly included), all `/upload/*`, `/stream/*` and `/ws` need authentication (`Authorization: Bearer ` first; where a header is not possible, `/WebSocket use the `?panel_token=` fallback), a missing or wrong token returns 401; only `system/auth/*` (the unlock entry) and the static pages stay open. The token is kept in browser localStorage (shared across tabs of the same panel address). The old `?token=` alias is removed (name clash with the Xiaozhi ota `token`), use `-H "Authorization: Bearer ..."` with curl or `?panel_token=`.

get.summary: Chest cmd 0x19. on=0 is NOT a servo power off, it starts the stock "Sit down" move.
get.description: Firmware analysis in Renode (chest V142 and V352, alpha2-brain#24) shows that cmd 0x19 [00] starts the stock "Sit down" move: the chest sends a move to all 20 servos. A standing robot can fall. When the charger flag of the chest is set, it does nothing. cmd 0x19 [01] sets the power on, which is already on from boot. The app refuses on=0 with a 400 unless allow_sit_down=true. To release the servos, squat and read each servo angle (cmd 6, /api/servo/angle). To hold them again, send a move.

parameters.description: 1 sends [01] (power on, already on from boot). 0 sends [00], which starts "Sit down" and needs allow_sit_down=true.

get.summary: Start or renew the servo read stream (cmd 0x17, event servo_reads)
get.description:
The app reads the servos `ids` with chest cmd 0x17 at `hz` in its own thread and sends one
`servo_reads` event on `/ws` for each cycle (see asyncapi.yml). Reads only: no move, no write.
The stream stops by itself `ttl_ms` after the last start call. Call start again (for example
each second) to keep it running. A call while the stream runs changes ids, hz, ttl_ms and raw.
A chest or servo firmware upgrade stops the stream before its first frame. During the upgrade
this call gives 409 (alpha2-brain#26). With `raw=false` (default) the replies to the stream do
not go out as `chest_rcv` events. Exception: when another requester (`servo/back-angle`, or a
cmd 0x17 frame on `debug/serial/send`) reads the same id, the next reply for that id goes out
as `chest_rcv` (alpha2-brain#29). Limit: ids x hz at most 200. alpha2-rl#3.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Servo ids split by commas (default 2,3,5,6,17,18,19,20, the 8 kg servos). Only the servos 2, 3, 5, 6 and 17 to 20 answer cmd 0x17. The app also accepts 21 and 22, but these servos are absent on the robot (UbxApi.java). The 20 kg servos 1, 4 and 7 to 16 give 400 (alpha2-brain#29).

parameters.name: hz
parameters.description: Read cycles per second (default 20)

parameters.name: ttl_ms
parameters.description: The stream stops this long after the last start call (default 5000)

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: Also send each reply as a chest_rcv event (default false)

400.description: A bad value, an id that does not answer cmd 0x17, or ids x hz above 200

409.description: A chest or servo firmware upgrade runs (alpha2-brain#26)

paused_cycles.description: Cycles skipped during a firmware upgrade or while the chest port is closed

last_read_ms.description: First send to last reply of the newest complete cycle (-1 = none yet)
